screen-sharing.q: Will the prompter be visible in my Riverside recording?
screen-sharing.a: No. Riverside records your camera feed and, if you share it, your screen through macOS — the prompter is excluded from screen capture and is never part of the camera image.

extraFaqs.q: Will my microphone pick up anything from the app?
extraFaqs.a: No. The app only listens; it never plays audio. Use the same mic for Riverside and for voice scrolling, or pick a different input in Settings → Audio.

extraFaqs.q: How do I use a teleprompter with Riverside?
extraFaqs.a:
1. Load your intro or question list into {{APP_NAME}} from the clipboard.
  2. Place the window right under your camera.
  3. Join your Riverside studio and start recording.
  4. Read naturally; backtrack or skip and it follows.
